source_title: Learning Color Compatibility in Fashion Outfits
source_author_or_org: Heming Zhang, Xuewen Yang, Jianchao Tan, Chi-Hao Wu, Jue Wang, C.-C. Jay Kuo
source_reliability_reason: Academic paper explicitly modelling colour compatibility as an outfit recommendation signal.
evidence_basis: The paper shows colour compatibility is a useful signal for evaluating outfit compatibility.
rule_limitations: Requires reliable colour extraction or metadata.
notes: Use as academic grounding for colour feature integration.
